snippet.title: Geo Challenge by Playfish
snippet.description: Play at http://apps.facebook.com/geochallenge - Geo Challenge takes you on a tour around the world as you put your geography knowledge to the test! You and your friends can prove once and for all who knows the most countries, flags and cities of the world. Play now to get your own Geo Challenge ranking, collect trophies and compare high scores with friends and other players worldwide!
